text: A command's `GroupID` selects the group under which that subcommand appears in its parent's help output (`command.go:73-75`). Groups themselves have an `ID` and `Title` (`command.go:41-46`) and are registered with `AddGroup` (`command.go:1356-1359`); help and completion commands have setters for assigning their group IDs (`command.go:332-345`).
